mechanism: Ketorolac (NSAID) increases mucosal irritation and bleeding risk; isotretinoin causes severe skin/mucosal dryness and increases photosensitivity, compounding GI injury potential and creating additive hepatotoxicity.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, use lowest ketorolac dose for shortest duration with gastroprotection (PPI), monitor closely for GI bleeding, and ensure adequate hydration.
